# Refund policy

This policy explains how customers receive refunds for returned products.

## Timelines

Approved refunds are issued within 14 days of the approval date.
Refunds go back to the original payment method.

## Eligibility

Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in the original packaging.
Gift cards and downloadable software cannot be refunded.

## Contact

Write to the returns desk to start a refund request. Include the order number.
